g.text: Integrated flow - one order, six cooperating patterns
Selected calls; HTTP, session and storage omitted.
Item/topping calls repeat for each requested item.
Herbs is a registered topping (+150 KZT).
Builder creates Order; its constructor calls
FAMILY selects 15% off a subtotal >= 6000 KZT.
then notifies the same subscribers again.
Operations receives reference, status and item quantity.
The order view separates its operationsEvents projection.
